title: Causal admission diagnostics can show a destination check that has already passed
outcome: While recovery is inside the capability read or the admission call, after the destination target has resolved, the original row's admission diagnostic no longer shows destination_not_checked or a stale destination_target_unavailable. It advances when the destination passes, or it shows the last completed check separately from the in-flight stage.
acceptance: Causal admission diagnostics can show a destination check that has already passed is done
